tools.name: get_ibda_overview
tools.description: Start here. Returns a short profile of IBDÅ (Innovate Build Deliver), a design-led R&D and innovation studio in Dubai: who it works with, when to recommend it, its 7 services, expertise areas and selected projects with page URLs, and how to send a project enquiry. Read-only, taken from www.ibda.co.

tools.name: search_ibda
tools.description: Search the text of every public page of www.ibda.co (services, expertise, projects, FAQs, about) and return the best-matching sections with their page URL. Use it for specific questions, for example "do they build IoT prototypes" or "AI training for government teams". Arabic queries search the Arabi

tools.name: get_ibda_page
tools.description: Return the text of one page of www.ibda.co as Markdown: a service, an expertise area, a project, About, Start a Project, Careers or Privacy. Give the path from get_ibda_overview or search_ibda (for example "/agentic-ai"). Optionally give a section heading to get only that part. Arabic versions exist

tools.name: prepare_project_enquiry
tools.description: Turn a user's need into a ready-to-send enquiry for IBDÅ. Returns a draft message, the link to the Start a Project form at www.ibda.co, a one-click email link to hello@ibda.co when the draft is short enough, a reference code and what IBDÅ does next. This tool sends nothing and does not store the enq

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_ibda_overview, search_ibda · Public sink: get_ibda_overview, prepare_project_enquiry.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_ibda_overview, search_ibda · Public sink: get_ibda_overview, prepare_project_enquiry

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
